CustomField.description:
Based on Dunns Number the records are identified as Parent/Child/Single Site
Parent ---DUNS_NUM = [GlobalUltiDUNS_NUM] Child records where DUNS_NUM <> [GlobalUltiDUNS_NUM] AND GlobalUltiDUNS_NUM <> '' Single site records where DUNS_NUM <> '' AND ( GlobalUltiDUNS_NUM = '' or GlobalUltiDUNS_NUM is NULL)
CustomField.label: DUNNS Record Type
